showcase.brief: Build a coherent industrial icon system for logistics dashboards and machine workflow interfaces.
showcase.problem: Generic SVG repositories created a Frankenstein visual language: mixed stroke widths, inconsistent corner radii, perspective conflicts, and auto-traced curves that broke UI cohesion.
showcase.solution: A single geometric system was built to normalize angle logic, stroke rhythm, shape weight, and detail density across every icon while preserving real machinery recognition.
